title.en: MALACAÑAN PALACE BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES ORGANIZING A PORTION OF THE MUNICIPALITY OF PAGALUNGAN, PROVINCE OF COTABATO, INTO AN INDEPENDENT MUNICIPALITY UNDER THE NAME OF PIKIT.

text.en:
OFFICIAL GAZETTE
dent municipality under the name of Pikit, with the seat
of government at Barrio Manding.
The boundary line between the municipality of Pikit and
the municipality of Pagalungan shall be the Pulangui River.
The municipality of Pagalungan shall have its present
territory minus the portion thereof comprised in the munic-
ipality of Pikit. Its seat of government shall be at the
barrio of Pagalungan.
The municipality of Pikit as herein organized shall begin
to exist upon the appointment and qualification of
the mayor, vice-mayor, and a majority of the councilors
Done in the City of Manila, this 29th day of September,
in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and forty-nine,
and of the Independence of the Philippines, the fourth.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
3737
By the President:
TEODORO EVANGELISTA
Executive Secretary
